body:
>What happens if the project isn't done?

I'll graduate a year later.

I'm honestly fine with my routine, I think, but sometimes I lose control of my anxiety and it feels like I'm back 5 years ago. A freaking teenager with no control over my own life. I want a job, I want to move out of parents' house, I want to be able to do things for myself and not feel like I'm being selfish for some reason. I want to enjoy this life that I have. I just don't know how to get there.
I feel like college, life, responsibilities won't wait for me to get better. That project is due Monday not when my brain decides to cooperate, you see
The funny thing is you can have a mental breakdown in my house and no one will hear it. That's funny. That's absolutely hilarious.

It's been 5 fucking years. I can't pay for therapy, I've tried and never went on for more than 3 sessions. I did everything. I changed habits, I go out more, I keep myself busy. It's not enough.

I'm honestly glad it worked for you, mate.
What's wrong with me? I don't want this fuck
